meta.note: Curated examples of what a bid item looks like. Each URL was opened on 2026-10-26 (HTTP 200, and the page or image was checked against the item). Plan-sheet page numbers are PDF pages in that letting set. Unmapped items and codes show nothing.
meta.extend: Add a by_item entry to explain a whole spec item (shown on the item header) or a by_code entry when one bid code needs its own example (shown only on that row). Each link is {"type","url","title"} plus optional "label". type is Photo, Past project, Plan sheet, Figure, or Bid tab. label, when set, must be the type or start with it (for example "Photo · inlet") so the tap target stays named by type. Use https only. Re-check that the URL returns 200 and is actually about that item before shipping. Do not scrape TxDOT at runtime. Prefer one to three links, and pick the kind that best shows the thing: a field photo, a real letting plan or estimate sheet, or an official figure. Leave codes with no honest example unmapped.
